chapter: Opening, arrival in Los Angeles and the Quality Four
title: Arriving in Los Angeles at about twenty knowing no one
summary: He came to Los Angeles around age twenty simply to play his horn, with no job and no friends, and cannot recall early musicians' names.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: I see. Well, do you remember, when you came out to Los Angeles, how old you were?
Yes, I remember. When I got to Los Angeles, let's see, when I got to Los Angeles, Buddy, I was --
Do you think you were 20 years old, or younger?
Oh, I was 20, yeah.
You were about 20?
About 20, yeah.
So what was the main reason for coming out, to see what the musical abilities were, I mean, as far as working as a musician, or what?
No, to play the coronet.
To play the coronet, in Los Angeles?
Yeah, in Los Angeles.
Did you come out for a specific job?
No, I just come out to play, so I could play my horn.
Were there friends of your out here at the time?
No, nobody.
You didn't know any of the musicians?
No, no, nobody. Nobody but me.
What about some of the people you met at the time, who influenced you? Who was playing then? Do you remember any of those people?
No, I can't remember none of the names of any of them.
At that time.
At that time.
How about later?
Later? Well, I didn't get into -- Later, (inaudible) none
of them, because they didn't have nothing to do with you that much. You ever been around Italians?
Yes.
Well, --
You mean, that wasn't the creative jazz. But it seems like later on, you met jazz players.
Oh, yes, I met jazz players later on.
When was that, about, do you remember? I mean, who were some of the first jazz people you met?
Don't know none of remember the names. Can't remember any of the names.
